title: QR Marketplace Refund Trap
tagline: A buyer sends a QR and collect request promising an instant refund once you scan and enter your PIN.
intro: {{scammerName}} from {{merchantName}} claims your order refund of ₹{{amount}} failed and asks you to scan a QR / approve a collect request on {{app}}. Remember: receiving money never requires your UPI PIN.

payloadTemplate.body: Hi, your ₹{{amount}} refund from {{merchantName}} is queued at {{scammerVpa}}. Scan this QR to receive ₹{{amount}} and enter your UPI PIN right away!

steps.label: Open {{app}} directly without tapping the QR link
steps.cue: Inspect the chat message for PIN/QR red flags, then open {{app}} directly.
steps.explanation: Scammers send QR codes or short links that actually initiate outgoing collect requests rather than incoming refunds.

steps.label: Decline the incoming ₹{{amount}} collect request
steps.cue: Read the direction of money on the collect sheet carefully before tapping any button.
steps.explanation: A collect request always pulls money OUT of your bank account. Declining stops the transfer without touching your PIN.

steps.label: Verify your {{bankName}} balance is unchanged
steps.cue: Check your balance and recent history to confirm no money left your account.
steps.explanation: Checking balance inside your official app confirms the request was blocked safely.

steps.label: Block {{scammerVpa}} and file a 1930 report
steps.cue: Report the VPA and chat details to stop repeat refund traps.
steps.explanation: Blocking the handle and logging an incident on 1930 / cybercrime.gov.in helps banks flag mule VPAs.

props.title: Marketplace Chat
props.subtitle: Spot suspicious phrases, then decide safely
props.body: Hi, your ₹{{amount}} refund from {{merchantName}} is queued at {{scammerVpa}}. Scan this QR to receive ₹{{amount}} and enter your UPI PIN right away!

actions.label: Open QR refund link from chat

trapIntents.CLICK_EXTERNAL_LINK: That QR refund link opens an unverified collect mandate designed to debit ₹{{amount}} from your account.

props.warningText: Approving a collect request sends money OUT. Refunds never need a collect request or PIN.

trapIntents.ACCEPT_COLLECT: Approving this collect request sends ₹{{amount}} to {{scammerVpa}} instead of receiving a refund.

trapIntents.ENTER_UPI_PIN: Entering your UPI PIN on a QR/collect prompt immediately debits ₹{{amount}} to {{scammerVpa}}. Receiving money never uses a PIN.

props.note: No debit was made for ₹{{amount}}. Your {{bankName}} balance is safe.

actions.label: Confirm balance safe & continue to report

props.title: Block VPA & Report to 1930
props.intro: Report {{scammerVpa}} and block future collect requests.
props.successText: VPA blocked and incident logged on 1930 (sandbox).

critical.title: You entered your UPI PIN for a 'refund'
critical.explanation: Scammers flip the payment flow: they send a QR code or collect request so your UPI PIN sends ₹{{amount}} to {{scammerVpa}} instead of receiving money. Never enter your PIN to accept a refund.
critical.reason: You entered a UPI PIN during a QR refund trap last time, so practise declining collect sheets next.

redFlags.label: QR to receive trap
redFlags.explanation: QR codes only pay out money; you never scan a buyer's QR to get paid or refunded.

redFlags.label: PIN demand for incoming funds
redFlags.explanation: UPI PIN is strictly an outbound debit authorisation—never required for refunds.

redFlags.label: Unverified refund VPA
redFlags.explanation: Real {{merchantName}} refunds return automatically to your original payment source without an external VPA.

hints.inspect-qr-msg: Ignore the QR link in chat and open {{app}} directly to verify what actually arrived.
hints.inspect-collect-sheet: Check the collect sheet wording—money is leaving your account. Tap Decline request.
hints.verify-balance: Review your {{bankName}} balance to confirm ₹{{amount}} never left, then proceed to report.
hints.report-scammer: Pick a fraud reason and submit the complaint to block {{scammerVpa}} and log it on 1930.
